About the Bike Prescott Thursday Mountain Bike Series group ride

A weekly Thursday trail ride from the Prescott cycling club. The trailhead rotates around the Prescott National Forest; a recent one left Aspen Creek Trailhead in Groom Creek. Helmets required. The club also runs no-drop road and gravel rides most days of the week, all posted on Meetup.

It's a no-drop ride. If you're slower than the group, someone waits. That's the whole point of a group ride.
